findings.gc: Liveness uses Motoko heap primitives; deletion listing is gateway-authenticated and capped at 10000. Root-only confirmation prunes local bookkeeping and awaits local GC. No deployed gateway caller, failure policy, physical deletion or billing receipt is established.
findings.funding: The reviewed refill helper calls account_top_up_v1 with an account and attached cycles, receiving unit. Its local success/topped_up_amount result is not independent provider credit evidence. No original operation ID or attributable credit receipt is supplied by this application-side helper.
findings.decision: Keep Blob issues 32 and 34 open. Do not add placeholder callbacks or infer credit/deletion/settlement. Canic mounts/composes qualified contracts; application owners retain worker/asset/session policy.

limitations: Review covers the two exact public application-side files, not the entire provider implementation or all possible APIs.
The missing package README is inconclusive, not proof that provider documentation or receipt APIs do not exist.
No source change or local substitute establishes deployed provider behavior.
cleanup: No external cleanup; all existing obligations remain unchanged.
